profile_text.body:
Box is a publicly traded company, founded in 2005 and headquartered in Redwood City, California, that offers what it describes as an Intelligent Content Management platform for storing, sharing, and collaborating on unstructured data such as documents, presentations, and contracts. The platform includes workflow automation with a drag-and-drop builder, AI-driven security with deep learning-based malware detection, automated data classification, access controls, and built-in compliance tools covering GDPR, HIPAA, and FINRA. The company also provides unlimited e-signatures as part of its content ecosystem.

Box AI is the company's primary AI product, tracked under the notes, knowledge, and meetings category, and covers enterprise content AI, metadata, governance, compliance, and retention policies. The site describes Box AI as drawing on models from OpenAI, Anthropic, and Google to deliver real-time summaries, deep analysis, and smart recommendations across enterprise content. Box AI Studio is presented as a tool for developers to customize agents and build agentic workflows within the platform.

Box trades on a public exchange under the ticker BOX with a CIK of 0001372612. Its most recent 10-K filing, covering the period ending January 31, 2026, reported revenue of approximately 1.177 billion dollars. The held facts indicate 174 California law exposure entries but no active litigation cases on record for this profile.
